scope: Exploratory original-patient-held-out prediction on historically viewed cohort and selected features; not independent external validation.
input: Exact immutable Experiment A R14 before patient-relative normalization; no feature extraction or new summary definitions
coordinates: Each feature has baseline-subtracted across-seizure mean and population SD. All valid pre/post record windows, approximately -29 to +29 seconds; not new 0-20s features.
label: Archived NEZ=1,EZ=0; analysis target EZ=1-y. Probability column for class1 must be checked.
outer_roles: Exact original five-fold FIT/CAL/Outer; FIT patients51/51/50/52/51; CAL13 each; Outer16/16/17/15/16. Outer channel counts1631/1498/1746/1425/1335. Every patient Outer once. No FIT+CAL refit.
inner_cv: Three patient-isolated subfolds from sorted FIT IDs shuffled by default_rng(42+1009*outer_fold), array_split into three. Same subfolds across14 arms and4 Cs. Each sub-FIT fits its own imputer/unit scaler/PR final scaler. Select C by equal mean AUROC over every held FIT patient, not unweighted subfold means. Within1e-12 of maximum choose smaller C.
weighting: For N FIT channels and P FIT patients: w_i=N/(2P*n_patient,class). Each patient has total N/P and each patient-class N/(2P); mean weight1. Recompute inside every sub-FIT and after label permutation; no pooled class_weight.
preprocessing: Coordinate-wise float64, FIT-only mean imputation, all-missing FIT coordinate->0. Unit scale from FIT StandardScaler. Current DREChannNet PR: per-patient mean/popSD, supported sd>1e-8*FIT unit scale, unsupported finite values->0, original NaNs preserved until FIT-only mean fallback. Final FIT-only StandardScaler for PR and NoPR. Original float32 feature-bank rounding then sklearn float64 in both branches. No clipping; infinities reject. Complete unlabelled channels of each query patient only; never a test-source-wide transform.
CAL_threshold: 201 EZ-probability thresholds0..1 step0.005; maximize equal-patient MacroF1; tie keys round MacroF1/EZF1 to12 decimals, then higher EZF1, nearest0.5, lower threshold. EZ iff pEZ>=threshold. Thresholds frozen before Outer.
negative_control: 100 fixed permutations b0..99, full12D+PR only. Each outerfold rng default_rng([42,20261025,fold,b]); shuffle labels separately within each FIT patient, retain counts, recompute class-balanced weights on permuted labels. Use that fold's true-FIT-CV-selected full+PR C and same label-free FIT preprocessing, own true-CAL threshold. No re-tuning C, direction flipping, null selection or Outer-label permutation. Descriptive conditional null distribution; no exact permutation-test p-value claim.
execution_barriers: All70 selected main/supplementary and500 null models/preprocessors/thresholds freeze before any new Outer inference; all570 predictions seal before aggregate metrics. Historical outcomes already viewed; no blinding claim.
unit: 80 equal-weight Outer patients; no pooled-channel substitute. Ranking within patient by unrounded descending pEZ; canonical channel name breaks exact ties, as prior evaluation.

bootstrap.CI: two-sided percentile95%, fixed trained models and splits, not retraining uncertainty

comparisons: AllSix+PR minus each of six prespecified single-feature+PR models and AllSixNoPR, all8 endpoints. Nominal95% paired patient-bootstrap CIs for56 rows. One28-comparison family=7 contrasts x4 primary endpoints; additional Bonferroni percentile CIs at1-0.05/28. Remaining28 endpoints and single-feature PR improvements descriptive nominal only. Extreme adjusted tails use about9 bootstrap order statistics; disclose Monte Carlo precision.
patient_variation: Retain seven one-seizure patients with degenerate SD coordinates. Audit per-coordinate raw nonzero variation and support under FIT-relative numerical floors for all80, no exclusions.
historical_LR: Reference only. Different pooled class weights, CAL-based matched PR-pair hyperparameters, C grid, tol1e-7 and legacy absolute-epsilon PR make exact reuse invalid. Zero historical models/scores reused.
privacy: Only source, aggregate tables/figures and compact public proofs exported. IDs, channel records, per-patient metrics/predictions, models/scalers/candidate scores and runtime logs remain trusted-server-only. No other experiment/source/model changes. CPU2, one BLAS thread, no neural/GPU fit.
